arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Stephen Vladeck argued the family should have a Bivens remedy for the shooting.
He noted the government previously conceded a remedy would exist on U.S. soil.
Michael Wall argued the family seeks to create a new cause of action.
He stated Congress has declined to provide a remedy in this context.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Sergio Hernandez died on Mexican soil after a U.S. Border Patrol officer shot him. His family seeks damages. The officer argues no legal remedy exists for cross-border incidents.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of federal damages remedies for cross-border law enforcement actions. It determines whether families can seek compensation for deaths on foreign soil. The outcome shapes the balance between individual rights and national security operations.
